name: The Kettle's Request
description: Old Hermit Yun would like proof you have walked among the bamboo: a single Bamboo Viper fang.

name: Study the Sutra
description: Read the Sutra of Empty Sleeves you were given, and return to Librarian Zhao.

name: The Locked Shelves
description: Zhao, quieter than usual, lifts the blue felt curtain of the west reading-room and pours you a cup. A page of the sect's catalogue — from the shelf the committee of 1184 sealed — went missing in a Black Banner raid on a scholar's caravan two winters ago. The bandit who has it is called Shao; he rides the old stone road east of the Merchant's Crossing, and wears the banner on his sash. Bring back the torn page. The library will be easier with you in it, Zhao says. He does not say easier on whom.

name: The Committee of 1184
description: Zhao, with the torn page laid between you on the west table, has been awake all night with it. The catalogue numbers reference a shelf the committee locked; the peg is still in the inner latch. But there is a second record — one of the committee's own, preserved not by the Azure Cloud but by a Jadestep scholar who understood what the Cloud had chosen to forget. It was buried at the Hanging Terraces with the sect that kept it. Bring it home. The library, Zhao says — not for the first time, though the first time aloud — will remember this.

name: The Envoy's Letter
description: Envoy Ruwen of the Azure Cloud has a sealed letter for Matriarch Shan of the Five Poisons Sect. Her arm is broken; she cannot cross the valley herself. Carry the letter to the Hall of Five Poisons, place it in the Matriarch's hands, and return.

name: The Missing Disciple
description: An inner disciple has not returned from the foothills. The frost wolves are hungry. Find any sign — and survive what hunts there.
